description: Artificial intelligence will help Surat police to locate the number of cyber crime cases in each area and identify the concentration and nature of cybercrimes in the city.
body_lead: The Surat police has adopted Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered solutions to train its personnel to reduce cybercrime and adhere to the cyber security needs of the citizens, a senior officer said.Surat Cyber Cell to protect the citizens of Gujarat from cybercrime. A chatbot has been created that will communicate with the victims in their chosen language," Additional Commissioner of Police (ACP), Surat, Sharad Singhal said.Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Ropar for the establishment of a first-of-its-kind in-house Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) Lab.
